authority.execution_authority: none; evaluation produces a receipt only
authority.authorized_automation: explicit policy, threshold, recipient, pricing, and deadline gates

contract.dry_run: always simulation-only with deterministic reason code
contract.human_approval: always human-approval-required unless a separate explicit policy authorizes execution
contract.authorized_automation: enabled policy and automation_allowed plus amount, entitlement, evidence, pricing, recipient, and deadline checks
contract.amount: explicit decimal string rounded to two money places
contract.receipt_hash: canonical decision hash over unsigned receipt
contract.fail_closed: invalid policy, candidate, threshold, currency, amount, or serialization rejects evaluation
